decision: The modern checkbox and its required validator become standalone, ripple and module metadata move, and fixtures and public guard change; the TODO is non-operative. Retain the owned checkbox and local required-validator directive with its NG_VALIDATORS multi provider, selector and aliases. That directive extends the public Forms CheckboxRequiredValidator; checkbox option types and default token are peer public exports, not the modern component metadata.
